tag_geometry_status: Boat mesh is rendered as fixed child yaw180, not as the overwritten root visual; marker/support offsets +3m align with its aft landing platform

provenance.navigation: Simulator ego pose and vessel truth for coarse approach only
provenance.visual_control: AprilTag camera measurement + simulator camera/ego pose; no target truth after acquisition
provenance.vessel_model: Planar surge/sway/yaw mass, added inertia, Coriolis and linear/quadratic damping, RK4 at 5ms; constant near-level hull anchor; not six-DOF wave/buoyancy validation
provenance.contact: Finite geometry queries and unilateral Coulomb support, reduced-order near-level landing gear; strict original success gate
provenance.image_preprocessing: Grayscale CLAHE clipLimit=2, grid=8x8 before actual AprilTag decoding; original RGB bytes/PNG retained; tag ID, hamming and margin thresholds unchanged
provenance.motor_off: Disarm actuator interlock in independent SimpleFlight build; physical rotor speed and thrust topics must independently confirm shutdown for entire 3 s dwell
provenance.bow_alignment: Reference image hull posture is preserved by body yaw-90 and fixed hull_visual child yaw180. Root visual yaw is overwritten by UE on motion and cannot apply this correction. Positive surge moves world -Y, away from shore; visual mesh bow -X maps to body +X, and marker/support remain at body +3m where their reference image placement is preserved. Direction is checked against consecutive fixed-camera RGB.
provenance.water_visuals: Simulation-clock small ripples and speed-driven foam; visual waves do not apply physical wave forces
provenance.vessel_control: Positive body-forward thrust; resistance feedforward from configured drag and speed feedback
provenance.video_protocol: Live rerun, fixed world observer, 1/8 wall-clock schedule, original 5 ms physical step, 40 Hz requested RGB/observer sampling, no interpolated motion
